name: guatemala-social-contributions
description: Use this Guatemala reference for IGSS contributions in 2026: cuota laboral, cuota patronal, the salario total base, the contribución mínima, the INTECAP tasa and IRTRA impuesto collected with them, registration, the Planilla de Seguridad Social, recargos and the voluntary routes. Match requests such as how much IGSS do I pay, IGSS employee rate, IGSS employer rate, INTECAP IRTRA, Guatemala payroll deductions, salario minimo Guatemala, bonificacion incentivo, Q250 bono, ISR retencion empleados, ISR planilla, constancia de retencion, SAT-1331, crédito por IVA planilla and IGSS bank statement transactions. It ties each rate to its instrument, holds the IRTRA rate, and sends ISR computation to guatemala-payroll. This Tier 2 draft supports source checking and reviewer questions; it does not authorise filing, payment or a tax position.
